```{r analyze-decision-uncertainty, include=FALSE}
# Comprehensive analysis of decision uncertainty
if (exists("psa_obj") && exists("WTP")) {
  
  # Calculate NMB matrix
  cost_matrix <- as.matrix(psa_obj$cost)
  effect_matrix <- as.matrix(psa_obj$effect)
  nmb_matrix <- effect_matrix * WTP - cost_matrix
  
  # Strategy performance analysis
  expected_costs <- colMeans(cost_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)
  expected_effects <- colMeans(effect_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)
  expected_nmb <- colMeans(nmb_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # EVPI calculation
  max_nmb_per_sim <- apply(nmb_matrix, 1, max, na.rm = TRUE)
  expected_max_nmb <- mean(max_nmb_per_sim, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_expected_nmb <- max(expected_nmb, na.rm = TRUE)
  evpi_calculated <- expected_max_nmb - max_expected_nmb
  
  # Optimal strategy analysis
  optimal_strategies <- apply(nmb_matrix, 1, function(x) colnames(nmb_matrix)[which.max(x)])
  strategy_distribution <- table(optimal_strategies)
  proportion_control <- strategy_distribution["control"] / sum(strategy_distribution)
  
  # Cost-effectiveness analysis
  incremental_costs <- expected_costs - expected_costs["control"]
  incremental_effects <- expected_effects - expected_effects["control"]
  icers <- ifelse(incremental_effects > 0, incremental_costs / incremental_effects, NA)
  
  # NMB distributions for plotting
  nmb_long <- data.frame(
    Strategy = rep(colnames(nmb_matrix), each = nrow(nmb_matrix)),
    NMB = as.vector(nmb_matrix),
    Simulation = rep(1:nrow(nmb_matrix), ncol(nmb_matrix))
  )
  
  # Store comprehensive results
  analysis_results <- list(
    evpi = evpi_calculated,
    expected_costs = expected_costs,
    expected_effects = expected_effects,
    expected_nmb = expected_nmb,
    strategy_distribution = strategy_distribution,
    proportion_control = proportion_control,
    incremental_costs = incremental_costs,
    incremental_effects = incremental_effects,
    icers = icers,
    nmb_long = nmb_long,
    optimal_strategy = names(expected_nmb)[which.max(expected_nmb)]
  )
}
```

# Introduction

This report presents the Expected Values of Partially Perfect Information (EVPPI) analysis for the METIMMOX-1 economic model. EVPPI quantifies the maximum value of obtaining perfect information about specific model parameters, helping to prioritize future research efforts.

However, the analysis revealed that there is **no decision uncertainty** in the current model, leading to an Expected Value of Perfect Information (EVPI) of zero. This report explores the implications of this finding for clinical and research decision-making.

# Methods

## EVPPI and Decision Uncertainty Framework

The EVPPI for parameter θ is calculated as:

$$EVPPI_θ = E_θ[max_j E_{θ^{-θ}|θ}[NMB(j,θ,θ^{-θ})]] - max_j E[NMB(j,θ)]$$

However, when EVPI = 0, this indicates that one strategy dominates all others across all parameter uncertainty ranges considered in the probabilistic sensitivity analysis.

# Results

## Decision Uncertainty Analysis

```{r decision-summary}
if (exists("analysis_results")) {
  cat("**Key Finding: No Decision Uncertainty Detected**\n\n")
  cat("- **Total EVPI**: €", round(analysis_results$evpi, 2), "\n")
  cat("- **Optimal Strategy**: ", analysis_results$optimal_strategy, " (standard care)\n")
  cat("- **Dominance**: Control strategy optimal in ", 
      round(analysis_results$proportion_control * 100, 1), "% of simulations\n\n")
  
  cat("**Interpretation**: The standard care strategy (FLOX chemotherapy alone) dominates all biomarker-guided strategies across the entire range of parameter uncertainty considered in the PSA.\n")
}
```

## Strategy Performance Comparison

```{r strategy-performance-table}
if (exists("analysis_results")) {
  # Create comprehensive strategy comparison table
  strategy_table <- data.frame(
    Strategy = c("Control (FLOX only)", "CRP-guided", "TLR-guided", "TMB/BRAF-guided"),
    `Expected Cost (€)` = round(analysis_results$expected_costs, 0),
    `Expected Effects (QALYs)` = round(analysis_results$expected_effects, 3),
    `Expected NMB (€)` = round(analysis_results$expected_nmb, 0),
    `Incremental Cost (€)` = round(analysis_results$incremental_costs, 0),
    `Incremental Effects (QALYs)` = round(analysis_results$incremental_effects, 3),
    `ICER (€/QALY)` = ifelse(is.na(analysis_results$icers), "Dominated", 
                             paste0("€", format(round(analysis_results$icers, 0), big.mark = ",")))
  )
  
  kable(strategy_table, 
        caption = "Strategy Performance and Cost-Effectiveness Analysis",
        booktabs = TRUE,
        col.names = c("Strategy", "Expected Cost (€)", "Expected Effects (QALYs)", 
                     "Expected NMB (€)", "Incremental Cost (€)", "Incremental Effects (QALYs)", "ICER (€/QALY)")) %>%
    kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position", "scale_down"), font_size = 9) %>%
    add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Absolute Values" = 3, "Incremental Analysis" = 3))
}
```

```{r nmb-comparison-plot, fig.cap="Net Monetary Benefit Comparison Across Strategies", fig.height=7}
if (exists("analysis_results")) {
  # Create comprehensive NMB comparison plot
  p1 <- ggplot(analysis_results$nmb_long, aes(x = Strategy, y = NMB, fill = Strategy)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.5) +

    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma_format(prefix = "€")) +
    labs(
      title = "Net Monetary Benefit Distribution by Strategy",
      subtitle = paste0("At WTP threshold of €", format(WTP, big.mark = ","), " per QALY"),
      x = "Treatment Strategy",
      y = "Net Monetary Benefit (€)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),

}
```

```{r cost-effectiveness-plane, fig.cap="Cost-Effectiveness Plane", fig.height=6}
if (exists("analysis_results")) {
  # Create cost-effectiveness plane
  ce_data <- data.frame(
    Strategy = names(analysis_results$incremental_costs),
    Incremental_Cost = analysis_results$incremental_costs,
    Incremental_Effect = analysis_results$incremental_effects,
    Expected_NMB = analysis_results$expected_nmb
  ) %>%
    filter(Strategy != "control")  # Remove control as reference
  
  # Add strategy labels
  ce_data$Strategy_Label <- case_when(
    ce_data$Strategy == "crp" ~ "CRP-guided",
    ce_data$Strategy == "tlr" ~ "TLR-guided", 
    ce_data$Strategy == "tmb_braf" ~ "TMB/BRAF-guided",
    TRUE ~ ce_data$Strategy
  )
  
  p2 <- ggplot(ce_data, aes(x = Incremental_Effect, y = Incremental_Cost)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Strategy_Label, size = abs(Expected_NMB)), alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_abline(slope = WTP, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", 
                color = "blue", alpha = 0.7, size = 1) +
    geom_text(aes(label = Strategy_Label), nudge_y = 2000, size = 3) +
    scale_color_brewer(type = "qual", palette = "Set1") +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "NMB Magnitude", labels = scales::comma_format(prefix = "€")) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.001)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma_format(prefix = "€")) +
    labs(
      title = "Cost-Effectiveness Plane",
      subtitle = paste0("WTP threshold: €", format(WTP, big.mark = ","), "/QALY (dashed line)"),
      x = "Incremental QALYs vs. Control",
      y = "Incremental Cost vs. Control (€)",
      color = "Strategy"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  
  print(p2)
}
```

## EVPPI Analysis Results

```{r evppi-explanation}
cat("**EVPPI Analysis Outcome**\n\n")
cat("Given that the EVPI is €0, no meaningful EVPPI calculations can be performed. This is because:\n\n")
cat("1. **No Decision Uncertainty**: The control strategy is optimal in 100% of PSA simulations\n")
cat("2. **Dominant Strategy**: Control consistently provides the highest net monetary benefit\n")
cat("3. **No Value of Information**: Additional parameter precision cannot change the optimal decision\n\n")
cat("**Technical Note**: EVPPI analysis requires decision uncertainty (EVPI > 0) to identify which parameters contribute most to decision uncertainty. When EVPI = 0, all parameters have EVPPI = 0 by definition.\n")
```

```{r parameter-sensitivity-context}
if (exists("psa_params")) {
  cat("**Parameter Variation Context**\n\n")
  cat("The PSA included variation in", ncol(psa_params) - 1, "parameters across", nrow(psa_params), "simulations:\n")
  
  param_names <- setdiff(colnames(psa_params), "sim")
  for (param in param_names[1:min(6, length(param_names))]) {
    param_values <- psa_params[[param]]
    cv <- sd(param_values, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(param_values, na.rm = TRUE)
    cat("- ", param, ": CV = ", round(cv * 100, 1), "%\n")
  }
  
  if (length(param_names) > 6) {
    cat("- ... and", length(param_names) - 6, "additional parameters\n")
  }
  
  cat("\nDespite substantial parameter uncertainty, the control strategy remained optimal across all scenarios.\n")
}
```

# Discussion

## Clinical and Economic Implications

```{r clinical-implications}
if (exists("analysis_results")) {
  cat("**Key Clinical Findings:**\n\n")
  
  cat("1. **Standard Care Dominance**: FLOX chemotherapy alone provides superior value compared to biomarker-guided immunotherapy strategies at the €51,000/QALY threshold.\n\n")
  
  cat("2. **Cost-Effectiveness Barrier**: Biomarker strategies add substantial costs (€", 
      format(round(mean(analysis_results$incremental_costs[-1]), 0), big.mark = ","), 
      " average increment) without sufficient QALY gains to justify the expense.\n\n")
  
  cat("3. **Robust Finding**: This conclusion holds across the entire range of parameter uncertainty considered, suggesting a robust economic finding.\n\n")
  
  # Identify why strategies are not cost-effective
  neg_nmb_strategies <- names(analysis_results$expected_nmb)[analysis_results$expected_nmb < 0]
  if (length(neg_nmb_strategies) > 0) {
    cat("4. **Negative Net Benefit**: The ", paste(neg_nmb_strategies, collapse = " and "), 
        " strategy(ies) show negative expected net monetary benefit, indicating they are not cost-effective even compared to 'do nothing'.\n\n")
  }
}
```


## Study Limitations

```{r limitations}
cat("**Limitations of Zero EVPI Finding:**\n\n")

cat("1. **Model Structure**: Results depend on current model assumptions and may change with different structural assumptions\n\n")

cat("2. **Parameter Ranges**: EVPI reflects uncertainty within specified parameter distributions; wider ranges might yield different results\n\n")

cat("3. **WTP Threshold**: Results are specific to the €51,000/QALY threshold; different thresholds may alter conclusions\n\n")

cat("4. **Time Horizon**: 10-year horizon may not capture long-term benefits of immunotherapy\n\n")

cat("5. **Perspective**: Healthcare system perspective may not capture broader societal benefits\n")
```
